lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered lattice of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in four primary horizontal rows and at least six visible vertical columns along the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal bands of similar intensity to form a grid-like structure, with circular high-luminance blobs situated at each intersection node.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible across the mid-to-upper flank, each displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow-induced lower luminance on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 8 to 10 high-luminance blobs are distributed across the surface of the first dorsal fin, with a higher concentration observed near the posterior trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (likely remoras) are visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral region of the flank.
